title: The mark as circuit
summary: A full-bleed FIG. 05 plate where the real Kelwin mark (K1 Narrative, K2 Channels, K3 Intelligence, exact proportions) becomes the circuit itself: market signal runs through the mark's two channels and loops around K2, and a Plurel segmented control flips it from Open loop (signal runs straight out and nothing returns) to Closed loop (the red return path is installed and the signal comes back round). It replaces today's row of bracketed cards and decorative arcs with one ownable picture of 'architecture, not tactics'.

reference.borrowed: Sunday's 'infrastructure behind the intelligence' composition: a two-line heading with a muted second line at top-left and a paragraph at top-right, then one wide dark plate split into a quiet stage list on the left and a large cycle figure on the right, with stage names placed around the cycle, a caption in one corner and the cycle's label in the other.
reference.kelwin: The plate bleeds the full 1440 as flat --panel with a caption band. Sunday's accordion becomes a three-row hairline key (01–03, each with a 16px glyph of the mark lighting its own piece, a 15px descriptor and the real item list). The tick-ring dial becomes the Kelwin mark at ×2.25 in flat fills (K1 --fg, K2 --cool, K3 --soft): the 1px circuit threads the mark's own channels (Narrative|Channels, then Channels|Intelligence) and wraps under K2. The only red is the 4px return path from Intelligence back into Narrative. Market signal enters from the left on a terminal square, and the compounding pipeline leaves off the right bleed edge. Sunday's '48 Hour Cycle' slot becomes the segmented control Open loop | Closed loop.

motion: entrance: the margin-to-margin hairline draws (900ms; graphite follows graphite). the label fades in (300ms), then the two statement lines rise out of masks (800ms, with the light clause 200ms behind). The 48×2 red rule draws, the lede, the quiet door and the annotation fade up 12px, the plate fades on and the key rows cascade (90ms stagger). The three pieces of the mark slide in from the top-right (700ms each, 120ms stagger). The input wire, Narrative's channel, the inner channel and the output wire then draw by stroke-dashoffset, and the labels fade in.

state change (the one orchestrated moment): the figure opens in Open loop, with the return path absent and the inner channel dimmed. Two signal squares enter on the market-signal wire, run Narrative's channel and leave off the right bleed edge as pipeline that resets. At about 3.0s the control auto-switches to Closed loop. The active segment slides across, the red return draws from Intelligence up into Narrative (900ms --ease-inout) and the inner channel brightens. The four signal squares then make exactly one clockwise lap through both channels and the return, and settle by about 6.4s. Nothing loops afterwards.

interaction: the control really works. Open loop retracts the red return and leaks signal off the edge, and Closed loop re-installs it and runs one lap. The caption updates with the state. Hovering a key row dims the other two pieces and lifts its station name to --fg. The quiet door's underline goes to --fg on hover and its drawn → moves 3px.
on the live site: the Open → Closed switch runs once when the plate is 50% visible. Reduced motion shows the final closed state with the squares at rest.
notes: Coherence pass: the head moved from Plurel's split to the hero's stack (96px statement, red rule, lede below, 'SEE HOW WE INSTALL IT →' as the quiet door), the ownership line under the plate became the bottom-right annotation ('■ Yours to keep'), the label left mono for the Mona caps label, and the Open | Closed control is tracked caps. The section is about 1310px tall with a 560px full-bleed plate. The mark uses the founder's corrected three-piece geometry at ×2.25 (K1 342px), and its channels measure 30–36px, so the 8px signal squares run inside them. The statement uses the source copy 'Three layers. / One closed loop.', which matches the three pieces exactly. Direction-coherence pass: A's one section rhythm is 112px top / 96px bottom in the render (160/160 on the live site); the head grammar is the hero's — Mona 500 11px tracked-caps label with an 8px red square (mono FIG. number at right), 96px two-voice statement on the display tokens with exactly one light phrase, 48×2 red rule, 20px lede in cols 1–6 (≤ 50ch, ≤ 3 lines), optional quiet door, and the founder's bottom-right annotation; FIG. numbers run 01–11 in homepage order; segmented controls are 11px tracked caps.
